    Critical pieces are connected #

    If the quiver of a convex piece C splits into two arrow-closed parts, an indecomposable representation lives on one of them (suppIn_or_suppIn), and both parts are convex (convex_of_closed). So if all smaller convex pieces are representation-finite, so is C (connected_of_critical).
